title: Polynomial-size arithmetic branching programs for factors via nonmonic Hensel lifting and reconstruction

Complete Section2 ABP/degree/size/resultant/PIT context, complete Section3 coefficient/homogeneous extraction, power-root truncation, multiplicity reduction, random monic transformation, coprime starting-point/resultant shifts, bivariate irreducibility and polynomial linear-system proofs, and complete Section4 nonmonic Hensel12 existence/uniqueness, iteration13/Claims14--15, resultant reconstruction16, explicit coefficient linear system and4.4 size analysis retained. core_obligations: Preserve characteristic-zero field and exact ABP edge-size/degree and factor premises.
Retain every preprocessing transformation and inverse with original random PIT/shift conditions.
Retain full nonmonic Hensel existence/uniqueness and iterative factor-tracking proofs, including Claims14--15.
Retain complete resultant reconstruction/coefficient linear system and final size analysis; do not split support/direct PIT consequences into extra tasks.
difficulty_reason: The authors avoid monic normalization inside each Hensel round so lifted factors remain small ABPs, track the target irreducible factor through nonunique unit corrections, and reconstruct it using a resultant argument and polynomial linear systems computable by determinants. The coupled nonmonic lifting/reconstruction mechanism is explicit and nonroutine.
